<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en" style="--bg: #050506; --panel: #111116; --border: #2f2f38; --accent: #d8d2c6; --text: #f4f0e8; --muted: #999489; --header: #070708; --button: #1b1a1d; --input: #0c0c10;"><head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
    <meta name="description" content="aarkme is a compact unsocial media profile for curated movies, albums, books, and games.">
    <title>aarkme — unsocial media profile</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
    <script src="supabase-config.js"></script>
    <script src="app.js" type="module"></script>
  </head>
  <body class="mode-public">
    <a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>

    <div class="ambient ambient-one" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="ambient ambient-two" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="noise" aria-hidden="true"></div>

    <div id="loadingOverlay" class="loading-overlay" hidden="">
      <div class="loader"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="toastContainer" class="toast-container"></div>

    <header class="site-header" id="siteHeader">
      <div class="brand-lockup" aria-label="aarkme brand">
        <a href="./" aria-label="aarkme home">
          <img src="assets/logo-aarkme.png" alt="AARKME unsocial media" class="brand-logo-image">
        </a>
      </div>

      <nav class="header-actions" aria-label="Profile actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" type="button" data-action="share-profile" title="Share profile">share</button>
        <div id="authStatus" class="auth-status-chip" hidden=""></div>
        <button id="signInBtn" class="ghost-btn" type="button" data-action="sign-in">sign in</button>
        <button id="signOutBtn" class="ghost-btn" type="button" data-action="sign-out" hidden="">sign out</button>
        <span class="save-status" id="saveStatus" aria-live="polite">local</span>
        <button class="ghost-btn public-only owner-only" type="button" data-action="enter-owner">edit</button>
        <button class="ghost-btn edit-only" type="button" data-action="preview-public">preview</button>
        <button class="ghost-btn preview-only" type="button" data-action="return-editor">return to editor</button>
        <button class="solid-btn edit-only" type="button" data-action="view-public">public view</button>
        <button class="solid-btn preview-only" type="button" data-action="view-public">exit preview</button>
      </nav>
    </header>

    <main class="app-shell" id="main">
      <aside class="profile-column" aria-label="Profile and editor controls">
        <section class="glass-card profile-card" id="profileMount" aria-label="Profile">
    <div class="profile-top">
      <div class="avatar-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Paledogg avatar" loading="lazy"></div>
      <div class="profile-copy">
        <h2 class="profile-name" data-profile-display="name">Paledogg</h2>
        <p class="profile-handle" data-profile-display="username">@paledogg</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="bio-display" data-profile-display="bio"><p>Um cara importante</p></div>

  </section>

        <section class="glass-card tool-card edit-only" id="themePanel" aria-labelledby="themeTitle">
          <details class="tool-toggle">
            <summary class="tool-summary">
              <span>
                <span class="eyebrow">theme editor</span>
                <span class="tool-title" id="themeTitle">Visual settings</span>
              </span>
              <span class="edit-pill">open</span>
            </summary>
            <div class="tool-panel-scroll">
              <div class="panel-heading compact-heading">
                <p class="tool-copy">Adjust colors, radius, and type locally.</p>
                <button class="tiny-btn" type="button" data-action="reset-theme">reset</button>
              </div>
              <div class="theme-grid" id="themeControls">
      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>background</span>
          <input type="text" value="#050506" data-theme-field="background" aria-label="background hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#050506" data-theme-field="background" aria-label="Pick background" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>panel/card</span>
          <input type="text" value="#111116" data-theme-field="panel" aria-label="panel/card hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#111116" data-theme-field="panel" aria-label="Pick panel/card" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>border</span>
          <input type="text" value="#2f2f38" data-theme-field="border" aria-label="border hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#2f2f38" data-theme-field="border" aria-label="Pick border" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>accent</span>
          <input type="text" value="#d8d2c6" data-theme-field="accent" aria-label="accent hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#d8d2c6" data-theme-field="accent" aria-label="Pick accent" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>text</span>
          <input type="text" value="#f4f0e8" data-theme-field="text" aria-label="text hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#f4f0e8" data-theme-field="text" aria-label="Pick text" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>muted text</span>
          <input type="text" value="#999489" data-theme-field="muted" aria-label="muted text hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#999489" data-theme-field="muted" aria-label="Pick muted text" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>header</span>
          <input type="text" value="#070708" data-theme-field="header" aria-label="header hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#070708" data-theme-field="header" aria-label="Pick header" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>button</span>
          <input type="text" value="#1b1a1d" data-theme-field="button" aria-label="button hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#1b1a1d" data-theme-field="button" aria-label="Pick button" disabled="" style="">
      </label>

      <label class="theme-row">
        <span class="theme-field">
          <span>field</span>
          <input type="text" value="#0c0c10" data-theme-field="input" aria-label="field hex value" disabled="" style="">
        </span>
        <input type="color" value="#0c0c10" data-theme-field="input" aria-label="Pick field" disabled="" style="">
      </label>
    </div>
            </div>
          </details>
        </section>

        <section class="glass-card tool-card edit-only" aria-labelledby="backupTitle">
          <details class="tool-toggle">
            <summary class="tool-summary">
              <span>
                <span class="eyebrow">backup tools</span>
                <span class="tool-title" id="backupTitle">Export / import</span>
              </span>
              <span class="edit-pill">open</span>
            </summary>
            <div class="tool-panel-scroll">
              <p class="tool-copy">Save or restore your local profile as a JSON file.</p>
              <div class="backup-actions">
                <button class="ghost-btn" type="button" data-action="export-json">export</button>
                <button class="ghost-btn" type="button" data-action="import-json">import</button>
                <button class="danger-btn" type="button" data-action="reset-demo">reset demo</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <input class="visually-hidden" id="importFile" type="file" accept="application/json,.json" style="">
        </section>
      </aside>

      <section class="content-column" aria-label="Curated media profile">
        <div id="mediaMount" class="media-mount">
    <section class="glass-card media-section " aria-labelledby="moviesTitle" data-section="movies">
      <div class="section-head">
        <div>
          <p class="eyebrow">movie shelf</p>
          <h2 id="moviesTitle">Movies</h2>
          <p>Cinema shelf: films, directors, moods, and private mythology.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="section-actions">

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="media-grid" id="moviesGrid">

    <article class="media-card media-public-card ">

    <div class="cover-wrap vertical" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="cover-placeholder is-movies"><span class="cover-mark">Movies</span></div>
    </div>

      <div class="card-copy">
        <h3 class="card-title">dgdg</h3>
        <p class="card-meta">dgdg · dgdg</p>


      </div>
    </article>


      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
      </section>
    </main>

    <div id="loginModal" class="modal-overlay" hidden="">
      <div class="glass-card modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <p class="eyebrow">sign in</p>
          <h2 class="modal-title">Welcome back</h2>
          <p class="modal-copy">Enter your email to receive a magic link. No password required.</p>
        </div>
        <form id="loginForm" class="login-form">
          <label class="field">
            <span>Email address</span>
            <input type="email" id="loginEmail" placeholder="your@email.com" required="" autocomplete="email" style="">
          </label>
          <div class="modal-actions">
            <button class="ghost-btn" type="button" data-action="close-login">cancel</button>
            <button class="solid-btn" type="submit">send link</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>

    <template id="imageInputTemplate">
      <label class="file-control">
        <span>upload image</span>
        <input type="file" accept="image/*">
      </label>
    </template>


</body></html>
